text:
sam_cs: Quick 20m at 11am PT to kick off NovusCare onboarding 4AA680. Need to align owners, must-have success criteria, timeline, and any immediate renewal/compliance flags. Who's available?
toni_pm: I can make 11. I'll own product acceptance and final sign-off.
leah_enable: I'll run enablement + API walkthrough. Proposed must-haves: e2e request flow, embedding sanity checks, Console access for ops, and a 1-paragraph feedback capture post-demo.
dan_se: I'll put together sample payloads and a tiny canary script. Flag: they asked about 12mo retention + AES encryption at rest. Need to confirm whether pilot requires those.
mike_eng: SSO is GA-only; ETA ~7-9 business days. Pilot fallback: token auth. Also flag: NovusCare asked for EU data tagging for a subset of records. That may affect infra choices.
sam_cs: Timeline idea: smoke tests within 48h, internal pilot by EOW, customer pilot next Wed if no residency blocker. Renewal: contract renewal in ~11 months; recommend capturing usage baseline month 1 and an executive readout at month 8.
toni_pm: Action items: @dan_se -> upload sample payloads to s3://novuscare/samples by 9am tomorrow with README; @mike_eng -> confirm SSO ETA + residency feasibility in JIRA; @leah_enable -> schedule 30m enablement (15m demo + 15m Qs) and create 5-question feedback form. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
leah_enable: Scheduling now. Confluence draft (WIP): https://confluence.redwood.ai/novuscare-onboard. Survey will be a short 5-question link posted here after the demo.
ops-bot: Note: NovusCare account flagged for renewal_watch = true; renewal_window = 11 months.
calendar-bot: Event created: "NovusCare onboarding kickoff" at 11:00 PT. Attendees: sam_cs, toni_pm, leah_enable, dan_se, mike_eng.
dan_se: :thumbsup: Samples uploaded to s3://novuscare/samples and README includes curl/python snippets + minimal canary (5rps).
mike_eng: Logged risks: "SSO_delay", "EU_tagging". Fallbacks: token-based pilot and dataset tagging via metadata for hosted route. Also creating ticket for DPA request re: 12mo retention.
sam_cs: Draft acceptance checklist (will formalize in Confluence):
```
- smoke_tests: pass
- p95_latency < 350ms
- embedding_spotcheck >= 0.9
- console_access: granted to ops
- residency_flag_resolved OR fallback agreed
- week1_usage_reported
```
toni_pm: Also add non-functional: monitoring alerts configured, cost baseline captured, fallback model pinned. If EU infra required, we'll call out timeline impact to customer.
leah_enable: After enablement I'll post a 1-paragraph summary + survey link here. Plan: daily 10m standups for first 5 business days to triage issues and capture feedback.
sam_cs: I'll send a one-pager to the sponsor and spin up the standups. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
